boundary_definition: A clean environment is one that contains only tracked repository source files, intentional documented configurations, and properly installed dependencies. It must not contain any residue from previous pipeline runs, previous renders, manual developer workarounds, or state files generated during prior executions.
rules: No reuse of old pipeline state
No reliance on manually downloaded media
No reliance on developer-specific environment overrides
No hidden cache reuse (e.g. npm cache must be isolated or ci used)
